title: S840 Pilot Defect Closure — DL-030 Content Defect Resolution

preconditions.s840_findings: 2 DL-030 content defects identified by pipeline Stage 3 independent solve

defect_1_p1b_d_138.topic: Multi-product CVP analysis — break-even with sales mix
defect_1_p1b_d_138.root_cause: Template rotation artifact — stem generated by one rotation pass (X: SP=$30, VC=$18; Y: SP=$50, VC=$30; mix=60/40), ExplanationCorrect and distractor explanations generated by different rotation pass (X: SP=$40, VC=$24; Y: SP=$60, VC=$36; mix=50/50). Stored CC=C matched EC's internal calculation but not stem data.

repair.strategy: Repair stem to match EC/choices data (all non-stem fields already consistent)

changes.stem_before: Zeta Company sells two products: Product X (SP $30, VC $18) and Product Y (SP $50, VC $30). The sales mix is 60% X and 40% Y. Fixed costs are $120,000. What is the total number of units needed to break even?
changes.stem_after: Zeta Company sells two products: Product X (SP $40, VC $24) and Product Y (SP $60, VC $36). The sales mix is 50% X and 50% Y. Fixed costs are $120,000. What is the total number of units needed to break even?

repair.verification: X CM=$40-$24=$16, Y CM=$60-$36=$24. Wtd-avg CM=0.5×$16+0.5×$24=$20. BE=$120K/$20=6,000 = Choice C. All fields internally consistent.

defect_2_p1b_d_144.topic: Relevant costing — constrained resource decisions (CM per machine hour)
defect_2_p1b_d_144.root_cause: EC independently calculated CM per MH: A=$30/2=$15, B=$45/3=$15, C=$50/4=$12.50. EC explicitly stated 'Products A and B have the same highest CM per machine hour... either can be prioritized equally.' Yet CorrectChoice was stored as C (Product A only), treating Choice A (Product A or B, both have highest CM per hour) as wrong. The original author attempted a tiebreaker argument ('Product A uses fewer hours per unit') which is not established management accounting practice for constrained-resource decisions.

independent_recalculation.ranking: A and B tied at $15.00/MH; C at $12.50/MH
independent_recalculation.correct_answer: Product A or B, both have highest CM per hour (Choice A)

repair.strategy: Change CorrectChoice from C→A to match EC's own analysis. Rewrite EC to clearly state the tie without tiebreaker. Restructure EW slots to provide choice-specific distractor explanations for the new configuration.

changes.explanation_correct: Rewritten — emphasizes equal CM/hr tie, removes 'fewer hours per unit' tiebreaker
changes.explanation_wrong_a: Original text → '' (new CC slot, DL-008 compliant)
changes.explanation_wrong_b: New distractor — explains B alone not uniquely preferred
changes.explanation_wrong_c: New distractor — explains selecting A alone ignores the tie

structural_verification.dl_026: 0 empty non-CC slots on both items
